information: Results for the Extra Events can be found here: [CubingContests](https://cubingcontests.com/competitions/OhioStateWeekendofMadness2024/results) #### This competition will feature many extra events for competitors to compete in for fun. **Events:** * 15 Puzzle * 2-man Mini Guildford (requires a teammate) * 2x2 One-Handed * 2x2-4x4 Relay * 3x3 Match the Scramble * Corner Helicopter 2x2 * Face-Turning Octahedron * Rubik's Magic * Master Pyraminx * Mirror Blocks * 3x3 With Feet ## To register for these events, visit the Unofficial Events (MUST READ) tab and fill out the form.
